description: This file implements a React component page for copying assets within a data asset management system. It handles user interactions for copying an asset, including form validation, initiating the copy request via API calls, displaying confirmation modals, and optionally fetching and displaying copy lineage information. The code manages various states of the copy flow (editing, confirming, submitting, confirmed) and integrates with external components such as loaders, modals, and breadcrumbs. It also performs structured logging and error handling.

methods.name: tryExtractCopyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts copy operation ID and target asset ID from an API response object, handling various key names and data types to ensure resilience.

methods.name: statusPillClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string based on the copy operation status for styling status badges.

methods.name: CopyAssetPage
methods.description: React component for the Copy Asset page, managing states, user interface, API interactions, and lineage display for copying assets.
